title.en: The Foolish Old Man Moves the Mountains (Liezi)

author.dates: traditionally 5th century BCE; text compiled by the 4th century CE

year_display.en: Text compiled by the 4th century CE
year_display.zh: 成书不晚于公元 4 世纪

edition.en: The story of the Foolish Old Man from the Tang wen chapter of the Liezi, as given on Chinese Wikisource.
edition.zh: 《列子·汤问》中的愚公移山一段，据维基文库。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text compiled no later than the 4th century CE; public domain everywhere.
basis.zh: 成书不晚于公元 4 世纪的古典文本，在全世界属于公有领域。

note.en: A fable from the Tang wen chapter of the Liezi, a Daoist book compiled by the fourth century CE. An old man sets out to move two mountains with baskets, and answers the clever neighbour who mocks him by counting generations. It is on this shelf because it is the plainest statement in Chinese of a work that outlasts the one who begins it.
note.zh: 出自《列子·汤问》，《列子》是一部成书不晚于公元四世纪的道家书。老人用箕畚去搬两座山，面对讥笑他的智叟，他用世代来回答。它放在这里，是因为这是中文里把“一件事比开始它的人更长久”说得最朴素的文字。

excerpt.orig: 子子孫孫無窮匱也，而山不加增，何苦而不平？
excerpt.en: Sons and grandsons, generation after generation, will never come to an end. But the mountains will not grow any higher. Why should we worry that they cannot be levelled?
excerpt.zh: 子子孙孙无穷匮也，而山不加增，何苦而不平？

gloss.en: Taihang and Wangwu are real ranges, on the borders of present-day Shanxi, Henan and Hebei.
gloss.zh: 太行山、王屋山：真实的山脉，在今山西、河南、河北交界一带。

gloss.en: 仞: seven or eight Chinese feet; ten thousand of them is a way of saying immeasurably high.
gloss.zh: 仞：七尺或八尺为一仞；万仞极言其高。

gloss.en: Jizhou: one of the nine ancient provinces, roughly present-day Hebei and Shanxi.
gloss.zh: 冀州：古九州之一，约当今河北、山西一带。

gloss.en: 河陽: the north bank of the Yellow River; the sunny 陽 side of a river is its north bank.
gloss.zh: 河阳：黄河北岸；山南水北为阳。

gloss.en: 懲: to be troubled by, to suffer from.
gloss.zh: 惩：苦于。

gloss.en: 豫: Yuzhou, another of the nine provinces, around present-day Henan.
gloss.zh: 豫：豫州，古九州之一，约当今河南一带。

gloss.en: 漢陰: the south bank of the Han river; the shaded 陰 side of a river is its south bank.
gloss.zh: 汉阴：汉水南岸；山北水南为阴。

gloss.en: 雜然: all together, everyone at once.
gloss.zh: 杂然：纷纷。

gloss.en: 曾: not even. 魁父: the name of a small hill.
gloss.zh: 曾：连……都。魁父：古代一座小山的名字。

gloss.en: Yintu: a place of legend in the far northeast.
gloss.zh: 隐土：传说中的地名，在东北极远处。

gloss.en: 荷: to carry on the shoulder. 夫: a grown man.
gloss.zh: 荷：扛、挑。夫：成年男子。

gloss.en: Baskets and scoops woven of bamboo or willow, for carrying earth.
gloss.zh: 箕畚：用竹、柳编成的盛土器具。

gloss.en: 孀妻: a widow. 遺男: the son her husband left behind; some read a son born after his death.
gloss.zh: 孀妻：寡妇。遗男：遗孤，一说遗腹子。

gloss.en: 齔: to lose the milk teeth, at about seven or eight.
gloss.zh: 龀：儿童换牙，约七八岁。

gloss.en: Winter and summer change places: a whole year goes by.
gloss.zh: 寒暑易节：冬夏换季，指过了一年。

gloss.en: 河曲: a bend of the Yellow River. 叟: an old man.
gloss.zh: 河曲：黄河弯曲处。叟：老人。

gloss.en: 惠 is read as 慧: clever.
gloss.zh: 惠：通“慧”，聪明。

gloss.en: 固: stubborn, set hard. 徹: to get through.
gloss.zh: 固：顽固。彻：通达、开窍。

gloss.en: 亡 is read as 無: he had nothing to answer with.
gloss.zh: 亡：通“无”。

gloss.en: The god who holds snakes: a mountain spirit. In the Classic of Mountains and Seas such gods hold a snake in each hand.
gloss.zh: 操蛇之神：山神；《山海经》记载有手中握蛇的山神。

gloss.en: Kua'e (also written 夸娥): a family of giants of legend.
gloss.zh: 夸蛾氏：又作夸娥氏，传说中的大力神。

gloss.en: 厝 is read as 措: to set down. 朔: Shuofang, in the far north. 雍: Yongzhou, in the northwest.
gloss.zh: 厝：通“措”，放置。朔：朔方，在北方。雍：雍州，在西北。

gloss.en: 隴 is read as 壟, a ridge; 斷, a height that cuts the way: no barrier of high ground.
gloss.zh: 陇断：山冈阻隔；陇，通“垄”，高地。
